signature.why: The payoffs, 4-of in 10/10 current field lists. Weapons Manufacturing is the engine, Pinnacle Emissary the value body it makes, and Kappa Cannoneer the ward-4 threat the deck wins with; a build without them is playing artifacts rather than playing this deck.

The zero-and-one-mana artifact count that makes metalcraft, Urza's Saga and affinity itself work. 10/10 field lists run Mox Opal, Urza's Saga, Mishra's Bauble and Tormod's Crypt at four copies each - the Crypt is a free artifact first and graveyard hate second.
